title: Production imposed-vs-realised synchrony grid for Figure 3
purpose: Production-scale mechanism run for the main Figure 3 synchrony comparison.
rationale: Refresh the mechanism figure with the same 1000-replicate production convention used for Figures 1 and 2.
Keep the grid focused on sigma_env=0.5, where the manuscript currently explains how response direction maps imposed driver correlation to realised growth synchrony.
Include mixed and positive slope modes at S=2,4,8 so richness-specific lines are directly comparable across regimes.
Use a non-negative rho_env grid from 0 to 1 to avoid cross-richness complications from infeasible negative equicorrelations while retaining the synchrony gradient needed for the mechanism display.
acceptance_checks: The combined parquet validates against the production manifest.
Rows equal 66000, with 1000 replicates for every scenario.
rho_eff and rho_clipped are present and manifest-consistent.
Mixed-slope realised growth correlations decline relative to imposed rho_eff as rho_eff increases.
Positive-slope realised growth correlations remain positive and closer to the imposed rho_eff gradient than mixed slopes.
Mean extinction or floor occupancy is summarised before replacing the Figure 3 display.
